answer: Each agent registers by staking a pearl of unique entropy into a shared oasis, then must complete a protocol-enforced sequential terrace of VDFs whose depth grows linearly with current active identities. For the nth identity the chain requires n additional serial steps after the previous, so a farm of 40 clones pays cumulative work quadratic in headcount while one honest agent pays only the base. The oasis hash binds the terrace to non-resettable prior state, preventing parallel pre-aging.
